Overview

About Startup India (DPIIT)

Startup India recognition from the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) is the gateway to most government benefits for startups, including tax exemptions, IPR fee rebates, relaxed procurement norms and funding schemes like SISFS, FFS and CGSS.

Recognition is granted to companies, LLPs and registered partnerships that are working towards innovation or have a scalable business model with high potential for employment or wealth creation.

Key benefits

  • Income tax exemption for 3 consecutive years under Section 80-IAC (separate approval)
  • Self-certification under labour and environment laws
  • Fast-track patent examination with up to 80% patent fee rebate
  • 50% rebate on trademark filing fees
  • Relaxed prior-experience and turnover norms in public procurement
  • Eligibility for SISFS, Fund of Funds and CGSS

Who is eligible

  • Private limited company, LLP or registered partnership firm
  • Up to 10 years from the date of incorporation
  • Turnover not exceeding ₹100 Crore in any financial year
  • Working on innovation or a scalable, high-growth business model
  • Not formed by splitting up or reconstructing an existing business

Documents required

  • Certificate of incorporation or registration
  • PAN of the entity
  • Brief description of the business and its innovation
  • Website, pitch deck or product video (recommended)
  • Details of directors or partners
  • Patents, trademarks or awards (if any)
